_instructions: REQUIRED: Configure your capability map, ICP criteria, Notion DB IDs, enrichment provider, and delivery destination for Capture Team (Chet, Kipp, Ben). Update whenever your capture process changes.

capability_map._instructions: One entry per placement-capable capability, for Chet's cluster discovery.

scanning._instructions: Sources Chet scans for new signals, and the minimum group size to qualify as a cluster.

icp_profiles.label: [e.g. 'Government contractor, 10-200 employees']
classification_criteria: [Signal or field that qualifies a record for this profile]

routing_flags._instructions: How Kipp's classified records get routed after intake.

enrichment._instructions: Kipp's contact/company enrichment provider and key.
enrichment.api_key_env_var: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the key itself here]

brief_structure._instructions: Section headers for Ben's brief output. Customize to your delivery format.
